mapper.sql: CASE WHEN R.RESV_TYPE = 'STAY' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_INQUIRY I WHERE I.MEMBER_NO = R.MEMBER_NO AND I.REF_TYPE = 'RESV' AND I.REF_ID = R.RESV_ID AND I.STATUS_CD = 'WAIT' AND I.TITLE LIKE '숙소 환불신청%' ) THEN 'PENDING' WHEN R.RESV_TYPE = 'STAY' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_INQUIRY I WHERE I.MEMBER_NO = R.MEMBER_NO AND I.REF_TYPE = 'RESV' AND I.REF_ID = R.RESV_ID AND I.STATUS_CD = 'APPROVED' AND I.TITLE LIKE '숙소 환불신청%' ) THEN 'APPROVED' WHEN R.RESV_TYPE = 'STAY' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_INQUIRY I WHERE I.MEMBER_NO = R.MEMBER_NO AND I.REF_TYPE = 'RESV' AND I.REF_ID = R.RESV_ID AND I.STATUS_CD = 'REJECTED' AND I.TITLE LIKE '숙소 환불신청%' ) THEN 'REJECTED' WHEN R.RESV_TYPE = 'STAY' AND R.STATUS_CD IN ('CHECKIN', 'CHECKOUT', 'DONE') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_INQUIRY I WHERE I.MEMBER_NO = R.MEMBER_NO AND I.REF_TYPE = 'RESV' AND I.REF_ID = R.RESV_ID AND I.STATUS_CD = 'DONE' AND I.TITLE LIKE '숙소 환불신청%' ) THEN 'REJECTED' ELSE NULL END
(SELECT F.FILE_URL FROM TB_FILE F WHERE F.REF_TYPE = R.RESV_TYPE AND F.REF_ID = TO_NUMBER(R.TARGET_ID) AND ROWNUM = 1)

(SELECT I.ANSWER FROM TB_INQUIRY I WHERE I.MEMBER_NO = R.MEMBER_NO AND I.REF_TYPE = 'RESV' AND I.REF_ID = R.RESV_ID AND I.STATUS_CD IN ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'DONE') AND I.TITLE LIKE '숙소 환불신청%' ORDER BY I.ANSWER_DATE DESC NULLS LAST, I.INQUIRY_ID DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY)
mapper.select:
SELECT R.RESV_ID AS resvId, R.RESV_NO AS resvNo, R.RESV_TYPE AS resvType, R.MEMBER_NO AS memberNo, R.PET_ID AS petId, R.PET_CNT AS petCnt, R.TARGET_ID AS targetId, R.RESV_DATE AS resvDate, R.RESV_TIME AS resvTime, R.TREAT_TYPE_ID AS treatTypeId, R.DOCTOR_ID AS doctorId, R.DURATION_MIN AS durationMin, R.END_TIME AS endTime, R.SYMPTOMS AS symptoms, R.REQUEST_MEMO AS requestMemo, R.STATUS_CD AS statusCd, R.REJECT_REASON AS rejectReason, R.REG_DATE AS regDate, R.CHECKIN_DATE AS checkinDate, R.CHECKOUT_DATE AS checkoutDate, R.NIGHT_CNT AS nightCnt, R.TOTAL_AMOUNT AS totalAmount, R.MEMBER_COUPON_ID AS memberCouponId, R.COUPON_DISCOUNT AS couponDiscount, R.POINT_USED AS pointUsed, R.ROOM_ID AS roomId, R.CANCEL_FEE_AMT AS cancelFeeAmt, R.REFUND_AMT AS refundAmt, R.CANCEL_AT AS cancelAt, P.PET_NAME AS petName, P.SPECIES AS petSpecies, P.BREED AS petBreed, H.NAME AS hospitalName, H.ADDR AS hospitalAddr, D.DOCTOR_NAME AS doctorName, T.TYPE_NAME AS treatTypeName, CASE WHEN RV.REVIEW_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS reviewedYn, S.NAME AS stayName, S.ADDR AS stayAddr, SR.NAME AS roomName, AS stayRefundStatus, AS stayRefundAnswer, AS thumbUrl FROM TB_RESERVATION R JOIN TB_PET P ON P.PET_ID = R.PET_ID LEFT JOIN TB_HOSPITAL H ON R.RESV_TYPE = 'HOSPITAL' AND H.HOSPITAL_ID = TO_NUMBER(R.TARGET_ID) LEFT JOIN TB_HOSPITAL_DOCTOR D ON D.DOCTOR_ID = R.DOCTOR_ID LEFT JOIN TB_HOSPITAL_TREAT_TYPE T ON T.TREAT_TYPE_ID = R.TREAT_TYPE_ID LEFT JOIN TB_REVIEW RV ON RV.RESV_ID = R.RESV_ID AND RV.MEMBER_NO = R.MEMBER_NO AND RV.REVIEW_TYPE = R.RESV_TYPE LEFT JOIN TB_STAY S ON R.RESV_TYPE = 'STAY' AND S.STAY_ID = TO_NUMBER(R.TARGET_ID) LEFT JOIN TB_STAY_ROOM SR ON SR.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID WHERE R.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}
AND R.RESV_TYPE = 'HOSPITAL'
AND R.RESV_TYPE = 'STAY'
AND R.STATUS_CD = 'PENDING'
AND R.STATUS_CD = 'CONFIRMED'
AND R.STATUS_CD = 'CHECKIN'
AND R.STATUS_CD = 'CHECKOUT'
AND R.STATUS_CD = 'DONE'
AND R.STATUS_CD IN ('CANCEL', 'REJECTED')
ORDER BY R.RESV_DATE DESC, R.RESV_TIME DESC, R.RESV_ID DESC

SELECT A.APPLY_ID AS resvId, ('TA' || A.APPLY_ID) AS resvNo, 'TALENT' AS resvType, A.MEMBER_NO AS memberNo, A.TALENT_ID AS targetId, A.REG_DATE AS resvDate, A.REG_DATE AS regDate, T.SCHEDULE AS resvTime, T.SCHEDULE AS talentSchedule, T.DURATION AS endTime, A.MESSAGE AS requestMemo, A.STATUS_CD AS statusCd, T.TITLE AS talentTitle, T.LOCATION AS hospitalAddr, B.BIZ_NAME AS bizName, T.THUMB_URL AS thumbUrl FROM TB_TALENT_APPLY A JOIN TB_TALENT T ON T.TALENT_ID = A.TALENT_ID JOIN TB_BUSINESS B ON B.BIZ_NO = T.BIZ_NO WHERE A.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}
AND A.STATUS_CD = 'PENDING'
AND A.STATUS_CD = 'CONFIRMED'
AND A.STATUS_CD = 'CONFIRMED'
AND A.STATUS_CD = 'CANCELLED'
ORDER BY A.REG_DATE DESC, A.APPLY_ID DESC

SELECT A.APPLY_ID AS resvId, ('TA' || A.APPLY_ID) AS resvNo, 'TALENT' AS resvType, A.MEMBER_NO AS memberNo, A.TALENT_ID AS targetId, A.REG_DATE AS resvDate, A.REG_DATE AS regDate, T.SCHEDULE AS resvTime, T.SCHEDULE AS talentSchedule, T.DURATION AS endTime, A.MESSAGE AS requestMemo, A.STATUS_CD AS statusCd, T.TITLE AS talentTitle, T.LOCATION AS hospitalAddr, B.BIZ_NAME AS bizName, T.THUMB_URL AS thumbUrl, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(T.BODY, 32000, 1) AS symptoms FROM TB_TALENT_APPLY A JOIN TB_TALENT T ON T.TALENT_ID = A.TALENT_ID JOIN TB_BUSINESS B ON B.BIZ_NO = T.BIZ_NO WHERE A.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND A.APPLY_ID = #{applyId}

SELECT R.RESV_ID AS resvId, R.RESV_NO AS resvNo, R.RESV_TYPE AS resvType, R.MEMBER_NO AS memberNo, R.PET_ID AS petId, R.PET_CNT AS petCnt, R.TARGET_ID AS targetId, R.RESV_DATE AS resvDate, R.RESV_TIME AS resvTime, R.TREAT_TYPE_ID AS treatTypeId, R.DOCTOR_ID AS doctorId, R.DURATION_MIN AS durationMin, R.END_TIME AS endTime, R.SYMPTOMS AS symptoms, R.REQUEST_MEMO AS requestMemo, R.STATUS_CD AS statusCd, R.REJECT_REASON AS rejectReason, R.REG_DATE AS regDate, R.CHECKIN_DATE AS checkinDate, R.CHECKOUT_DATE AS checkoutDate, R.NIGHT_CNT AS nightCnt, R.TOTAL_AMOUNT AS totalAmount, R.MEMBER_COUPON_ID AS memberCouponId, R.COUPON_DISCOUNT AS couponDiscount, R.POINT_USED AS pointUsed, R.ROOM_ID AS roomId, R.CANCEL_FEE_AMT AS cancelFeeAmt, R.REFUND_AMT AS refundAmt, R.CANCEL_AT AS cancelAt, P.PET_NAME AS petName, P.SPECIES AS petSpecies, P.BREED AS petBreed, COALESCE(H.NAME, S.NAME) AS hospitalName, COALESCE(H.ADDR, S.ADDR) AS hospitalAddr, D.DOCTOR_NAME AS doctorName, T.TYPE_NAME AS treatTypeName, CASE WHEN RV.REVIEW_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS reviewedYn, SR.NAME AS roomName, AS stayRefundStatus, AS stayRefundAnswer, AS thumbUrl FROM TB_RESERVATION R JOIN TB_PET P ON P.PET_ID = R.PET_ID LEFT JOIN TB_HOSPITAL H ON R.RESV_TYPE = 'HOSPITAL' AND H.HOSPITAL_ID = TO_NUMBER(R.TARGET_ID)
LEFT JOIN TB_HOSPITAL_DOCTOR D ON D.DOCTOR_ID = R.DOCTOR_ID LEFT JOIN TB_HOSPITAL_TREAT_TYPE T ON T.TREAT_TYPE_ID = R.TREAT_TYPE_ID LEFT JOIN TB_REVIEW RV ON RV.RESV_ID = R.RESV_ID AND RV.MEMBER_NO = R.MEMBER_NO AND RV.REVIEW_TYPE = R.RESV_TYPE LEFT JOIN TB_STAY S ON R.RESV_TYPE = 'STAY' AND S.STAY_ID = TO_NUMBER(R.TARGET_ID) LEFT JOIN TB_STAY_ROOM SR ON SR.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID WHERE R.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND R.RESV_ID = #{resvId}

INSERT INTO TB_REVIEW ( REVIEW_ID, REVIEW_TYPE, TARGET_ID, MEMBER_NO, RESV_ID, RATING, CONTENT, REG_DATE ) VALUES ( #{reviewId}, 'HOSPITAL', #{targetId}, #{memberNo}, #{resvId}, #{rating}, #{content, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT MEMBER_NO FROM TB_HOSPITAL WHERE HOSPITAL_ID = #{hospitalId}
SELECT NICKNAME FROM TB_MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}

SELECT NVL(MAX(REVIEW_ID), 0) + 1 FROM TB_REVIEW
INSERT INTO TB_REVIEW ( REVIEW_ID, REVIEW_TYPE, TARGET_ID, MEMBER_NO, RESV_ID, RATING, CONTENT, REG_DATE ) VALUES ( #{reviewId}, 'STAY', #{targetId}, #{memberNo}, #{resvId}, #{rating}, #{content, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE )

INSERT INTO TB_POINT ( POINT_ID, MEMBER_NO, POINT_TYPE, POINT_AMOUNT, BALANCE_AFTER, REASON_CD, REF_TYPE, REF_ID, REG_DATE ) VALUES ( (SELECT NVL(MAX(POINT_ID), 0) + 1 FROM TB_POINT), #{memberNo}, 'EARN', #{pointAmount}, #{balanceAfter}, 'REVIEW', #{refType}, #{refId}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT NVL(POINT_BALANCE, 0) FROM TB_MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}
SELECT MEMBER_NO FROM TB_STAY WHERE STAY_ID = #{stayId}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_RESERVATION SET STATUS_CD = 'CANCEL', REJECT_REASON = #{rejectReason, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CANCEL_FEE_AMT = #{cancelFeeAmt}, REFUND_AMT = #{refundAmt}, CANCEL_AT = SYSDATE WHERE RESV_ID = #{resvId} AND MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND RESV_TYPE = 'STAY' AND STATUS_CD = 'CONFIRMED'
mapper.select: SELECT PAYMENT_ID AS "paymentId", TOSS_PAYMENT_KEY AS "tossPaymentKey", PAY_AMOUNT AS "payAmount", PAY_STATUS AS "payStatus", REFUND_AMT AS "refundAmt", PAY_METHOD AS "payMethod" FROM TB_PAYMENT WHERE RESV_ID = #{resvId} AND PAY_TYPE = 'RESERVATION' AND PAY_STATUS = 'DONE' AND ROWNUM = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_PAYMENT SET REFUND_AMT = #{refundAmt}, PAY_STATUS = 'REFUND' WHERE RESV_ID = #{resvId} AND PAY_TYPE = 'RESERVATION' AND PAY_STATUS = 'DONE'
